$comment: THE LIST CI RUNS, not a description of one (#396, stage 1).
scripts/run-checks.mjs iterates this file and ci.yml invokes that runner, so an entry
here IS an execution. A declared list CI did not iterate would be a second source of
truth and worse than the YAML it replaced: it would report a set nobody ran.
Each entry runs its PROOF first and its CHECKER second, in one process, because a
checker whose proof did not run is a checker nobody has watched fail. That ordering was
previously spelled out in six separate `pnpm <name>` scripts chaining `&&`; it is now a
property of the runner, so it cannot be forgotten on the seventh.
STAGE 1 covers only the six that already had the proof-first form. The other 45 checker
steps in ci.yml keep their own steps and pairing keeps parsing YAML for them.

checks.name: route-stubs
checks.why: a route stub matching more than one real endpoint answers requests it was never written for (#379)

checks.name: fixture-premises
checks.why: a fixture that plants into a directory-owned glob must say so, or a reparent leaves it green about nothing (#375)

checks.name: manifest-coupling
checks.why: rung coupling that travels through the generated types (#374)

checks.name: langfuse-wiring
checks.why: observability wiring present in every backend, not only the one someone tested

checks.name: github-reporter
checks.why: a failing e2e job names the test that failed (#362)

checks.name: run-axes-parity
checks.why: the run axes agree across backends rather than each backend deciding separately

checks.name: required-contexts
checks.why: branch protection names required checks in a second place, and a rename makes the two disagree in silence in one direction and in permanent deadlock in the other (#404)

checks.name: coverage-surface
checks.why: a shared surface covered only by rung-owned specs loses its tests to an eject while keeping the feature (#373)

checks.name: overrides-inert
checks.why: an override carrying a version selector stops applying once a resolution rises above it, and reads as protection while doing nothing (#378)

checks.name: parity-tsconfig
checks.why: a cross-package suite excluded from the package program and absent from the parity include is in NO program: green, and never typechecked (#430)
